newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian bank NKBM says 96 net profit up 10.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian bank NKBM says 96 net profit up 10.6 pct.

text.p: Slovenia's third largest bank Nova Kreditna Banka Maribor (NKBM) said on Monday 1996 net profit rose to 1.95 billion tolars ($12.4 million) from 1.76 billion a year before.
State-owned NKBM said profits improved due to a broadening out of its banking business and due to lower costs.
But the 1996 net profit failed to reach the company's forecast, made in January, of 2.1 billion tolars.
Balance sheet assets rose to 204.9 billion tolars from 197.2 billion.
The Bank of Slovenia on Friday said NKBM, along with Slovenia's largest bank Nova Ljubljanska Banka (NLB), fulfilled conditions to end its restructuring process which started in 1993.
The end of restructuring gives the green light for a future privatisation of both banks, expected to start in 1998. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
